faqs.question: OPD appointment kaise book karein?
faqs.answer: Aap seedhe is WhatsApp par doctor ka naam, department ya apni bimari/problem likh kar bhej sakte hain. Hamara AI assistant aapko available time slots dikha kar turant book kar dega.

faqs.question: Emergency me kya karein?
faqs.answer: Emergency ke liye turant hamare 24x7 helpline +91 5252 232911 par call karein ya seedhe Hospital Road, Basheerganj, Bahraich sthit Emergency ward me aayein. Ambulance uplabdh hai.

faqs.question: Reports WhatsApp par kaise milengi?
faqs.answer: Test hone ke 4 se 6 ghante baad aapki diagnostic/pathology report is WhatsApp number par PDF format me automatically bhej di jayegi.

faqs.question: Ayushman Bharat Card chalta hai kya?
faqs.answer: Haan, hamare yahan Ayushman Bharat (PM-JAY) aur sabhi major TPA insurance companies ke cashless elaj ki suvidha uplabdh hai.

conversations.last_message_text:
Maaf kijiye, aaj (30 August 2026) Dr. Rahul Sharma ke paas koi bhi slot available nahi hai.

Kya aap kal (31 August 2026) ya kisi aur din ke liye appointment book karna chahenge?

Namaste Amit ji! 🙏  

Dr. Rahul Sharma har din **09:00 – 19:00** tak OPD mein hote hain (Monday‑Saturday). Unka break 13:00‑14:30 hota hai, isliye shaam ke 5:30 baje ka slot bilkul theek hai – lekin kal (30 Aug 2026) **Sunday** hai, jab clinic band rehta hai.  

Kya aap **Monday, 31 Aug 2026 ko 5:30 PM** ka appointment confirm karna chahenge? Ya koi aur din jo aapke liye suvidha janak ho, batayein.  

Aapki suvidha ke liye, appointment confirm hote hi hum aapko SMS/WhatsApp se yaad‑dihani bhej denge.  

Aapka jawab ka intezar rahega!  

— Zain Hospital & Research Centre, Bahraich 🌼

Ji haan, **Ayushman Bharat (PM‑JAY) card** humare Zain Hospital & Research Centre mein cashless treatment ke liye accept kiya jata hai.  

Saath hi, Star Health, HDFC ERGO, ICICI Lombard, Care Health, Niva Bupa, Bajaj Allianz, aur UP State Health Scheme jaise major TPA‑s bhi hum support karte hain.  

Koi aur sawal ho ya appointment book karna ho, toh zaroor batayein.  

Emergency ke liye 24 × 7 helpline: **+91 5252 232911**.  

Dhanyavaad, aapka din shubh ho!

🙏 Ji, heart attack जैसी गंभीर स्थिति में तुरंत मदद के लिए कृपया हमारे 24 x 7 Emergency हेल्पलाइन पर कॉल करें:

**📞 +91 5252 232911**

कॉल करते समय अपनी सटीक लोकेशन (पता या नज़दीकी लैंडमार्क) बताना न भूलें, ताकि एम्बुलेंस तुरंत पहुँच सके।  

हमारी पूरी टीम आपकी सहायता के लिए तत्पर है। कृपया अभी कॉल करें। 🙏

Namaste! 🙏

मैं **डॉ. राहुल शर्मा** (Cardiology) के साथ **कल (30‑Aug‑2026) शाम 6:00 बजे** आपका अपॉइंटमेंट बुक करने की कोशिश कर रहा हूँ।  

बुकिंग के लिए मुझे आपका **पूरा नाम**, **उम्र (साल में)** और **लिंग** (Male / Female / Other) चाहिए।  

कृपया ये जानकारी दें, फिर मैं तुरंत स्लॉट की पुष्टि करके अपॉइंटमेंट बना दूँगा।  

धन्यवाद! 😊

Namaste ji! 🙏 Aapka swagat hai **Zain Hospital & Research Centre, Bahraich** mein. Yahan aapki maangi hui jaankari hai:

🕐 **OPD Timings:**
- **Monday to Saturday:** 8:30 AM – 7:30 PM
- **Sunday:** 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM
- **Emergency:** 24x7 available hai

🚑 **Emergency Helpline (24x7):**
**+91 5252 232911**

Koi bhi emergency ho toh turant is number par call karein ya seedhe **Hospital Road, Basheerganj, Bahraich** wale Emergency ward mein aayein. Ambulance bhi uplabdh hai.

Kya main aapke liye kisi doctor se appointment book karun? Bas doctor ka naam, department ya apni bimari/problem bata dijiye. 😊

Namaste! Main Zain Hospital & Research Centre ka Patient Care Agent hoon. 🙏

Aapki dawai 10 din ki course ke baad khatam ho rahi hai — yeh bahut accha hai ki aapne yahan check-in kiya hai.

Kuch important baatein:

1. **Dawai band karne se pehle doctor se consult karna zaroori hai.** Kabhi-kabhi doctor course khatam hone ke baad bhi kuch aur din dawai chalne ko kehte hain, ya koi test karwate hain.
2. **Main dawai band ya change nahi kar sakta** — yeh sirf aapke treating doctor hi decide kar sakte hain.

Kya aap chahte hain ki main aapke **treating doctor ke saath follow-up consultation** book kar doon? Isse aap doctor se directly baat karke pata laga sakte hain ki:
- Dawai ab band karni hai ya nahi
- Koi follow-up test chahiye ya nahi
- Recovery kaisi chal rahi hai

Agar haan, toh mujhe bataiye:
- **Aapka naam** kya hai?
- **Kaunsa department/doctor** aapka treating doctor hai? (jaise Cardiology, General Medicine, etc.)
- **Kis din** follow-up chahiye? (Aapne 29 Aug 2026 mention kiya hai — kya yehi date theek hai?)

Agar aapko abhi koi **serious symptom** ho raha hai (jaise tez dard, saans lene mein takleef, achanak kamzori), toh turant **24x7 Emergency Room** mein jayein ya **+91 5252 232911** par call karein.

Bilkul ji, main aapko reception staff se connect kar raha hoon. Kisi staff member ne aapke baare mein jaankari le li hai aur wo jald hi aapse baat karenge.

Kripya thoda intezaar karein, koi staff member jald hi aapke saath connect hoga. 🙏

Namaste Ramesh ji! 🙏

Zain Hospital me **Orthopaedics** department me yeh doctors available hain:

| 👨‍⚕️ Doctor | Qualification | OPD Timing |
|---|---|---|
| **Dr. Anil Verma** | MBBS, MS (Ortho) | Mon–Sat, 10:00 AM – 2:00 PM |
| **Dr. Sunita Rao** | MBBS, MS (Ortho) | Mon–Sat, 11:00 AM – 3:00 PM |

📅 **Aaj (29 Aug 2026, Friday)** dono doctors milenge:
- **Dr. Anil Verma** → 10:00 AM – 2:00 PM
- **Dr. Sunita Rao** → 11:00 AM – 3:00 PM

- Kaunsa doctor? (Anil Verma / Sunita Rao)

Main turant available slots check karke aapko bata dunga! 😊
